generation_inputs.preparation: Exact 32x nearest-neighbour enlargement of native 24x24 PNG, without recolouring or aspect correction.

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: faithful high-resolution game water terrain redraw, for 48x48 and 96x96 exports from an original 24x24 Amiga tile.
Input image is the ORIGINAL SCOAS060, exactly enlarged32x, sole geometry and colour authority. Redraw this exact all-water tile with restrained illustrated ripples INSIDE its original colour patches. Preserve every patch position, size and stepped contour, including the tiny pale grey and white crest cells. Keep original per-cell mean colours: main water #448899, dark water #335566, cyan reflections #55bbbb, small pale #bbbbbb and white #ffffff crests. Keep precisely the original amounts and placement of dark, midtone, cyan and pale water. Downsampling to24x24 should look nearly identical. Add gentle fine irregular water-surface detail below original-cell scale; modest contrast, quiet broad areas, no busy rows of bright strokes. Keep grey/white crest locations distinct and crisp, never enlarge them or create additional foam. No shore, ground, rocks, vegetation, bridge, boat, perspective, new objects, large waves, extra shadows, colour grade or global lighting.
Paint a FULLY OPAQUE SQUARE including formerly transparent corners, continuing adjacent water colours beyond the old footprint. Exact original stepped hex masking will be performed afterward; exterior paint will be discarded. No hex border, outline, inset, bevel, checkerboard, black matte, text or watermark. Preserve original material map registration and colours while adding genuine subtle high-resolution surface detail.
cleanup: Generated source retained unchanged as fully opaque square paint, including deliberate material extensions outside native coverage. tools/art-review area-reduces to 96x96, applies repeated original mask, box-reduces to 48x48 and 24x24 with coverage caps. No alpha forcing, matte replacement, display-aspect or world-spacing correction. Exterior paint is discarded by the original mask; raw extra coverage is expected.
review: Rejected by user on 2026-10-15: high-resolution artwork still visibly preserves original square pixel cells. Retained as history; exact alpha and previous assistant scores do not approve the artwork.
determinism: AI reruns are not assumed deterministic; exports reproduce locally from retained source using tools/art-review.
